name: Anonymous visitors cannot open the admin workspace
description: Verifies the workspace remains hidden until AppDeploy restores an authenticated, authorized owner session.
steps: Open the Alpha Mate Admin URL in a signed-out browser session
Inspect the page before signing in
expected: The admin dashboard is not shown; the secure sign-in screen displays the authorized Super Admin email.

name: Authorized temporary Super Admin can sign in and verify Firebase
description: Verifies the authorized owner can authenticate and the protected backend reports the Firebase Firestore connection status.
steps: Sign in using alphamateapp@gmail.com and complete the email link
Wait for the admin workspace to load
expected: The owner sees the admin workspace and a Firebase connection status showing the configured project when the service account has Firestore access.

name: Non-owner accounts are denied Super Admin access
description: Verifies an authenticated email outside the explicit owner allowlist cannot access the admin API or workspace.
steps: Authenticate with an email other than alphamateapp@gmail.com
expected: The session is rejected and the admin dashboard remains inaccessible.

name: Owner can sign out and the workspace is protected again
description: Verifies signing out clears the owner session and returns the user to the secure login screen on mobile.
steps: Open the profile menu and choose Sign out
expected: The session is cleared and the secure sign-in screen appears instead of the admin dashboard.

name: Firebase connection failures are shown without exposing credentials
description: Verifies a Firestore connection failure produces a safe status response and never exposes the service-account JSON or private key.
steps: Sign in as the authorized owner while the Firestore service account is unavailable or lacks access
Inspect the Firebase connection banner and network response
expected: A generic connection warning is shown; no credential values, private key, or raw secret content is returned.
